style_notes: Analog 35mm film photography, Kodak Portra 400 grain structure, heavily muted desaturated palette. Abstract and conceptual — never literal, never illustrative. No people, no faces, no obvious religious iconography. Evoke emotional and theological truth through texture, light, shadow, and negative space alone. Think Alabaster Books meets Kinfolk magazine: spare, intimate, unhurried. Objects minimal or absent. Light does the storytelling.
color_palette: Warm pale stone, scattered terracotta, dust, ochre wall light, cream papyrus, cool morning light, weathered marble, faded engraving — heavily desaturated with analog film warmth
